Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/llm

src/agent_runtime/llm/init.py

Python · Tier A

LLM boundary interfaces for structured calls and repair.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
build_openai_compatible_llm_client 19 Build the selected model-protocol adapter behind the shared LLM contract.

src/agent_runtime/llm/answer_stream.py

Python · Tier A

Project eligible native answer fragments into batched cumulative UI callbacks. Exact tool identity, output-contract eligibility, incremental syntax checks and current redaction policy govern provisional text. Invalid previews can be withdrawn; this module cannot accept a task outcome or execute a tool.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
NativeAnswerStream 17 Publish cumulative provisional answer text through a callback while response assembly and completion validation retain authority. With no tools, project assistant content; with tools, require an eligible exact finish_task message schema. OutputStream applies the current model- output redaction policy without rewriting the provider response.
NativeAnswerStream.invalidate 64 Latch preview rejection and send one empty invalidation event if text was already published. Do not retry inference, mutate assembled arguments or decide the task outcome.
NativeAnswerStream.preserve_final 75 Allow an already published valid preview to remain when the completed envelope contains final-response text recognized by inspect_message. The transport supplies completion and call-mode fences; this check neither accepts completion nor compares the preview byte-for- byte with the final text.
NativeAnswerStream.add 92 Observe one assembled delta for presentation. Plain mode rejects tool calls; tool mode buffers fragments until the exact finish_task name is known, then extracts only its root message string. A conflicting name or invalid JSON withdraws the provisional output.
NativeAnswerStream.finish 149 Flush only after the transport has validated the complete response and accounted for usage. An incomplete selected message invalidates the preview; a disabled or never-selected finish channel publishes nothing.

src/agent_runtime/llm/brain_freeze.py

Python · Tier A

Carry live decision controls and numeric soft-target observations without retaining private reasoning. Valid provider counts take precedence over explicit UTF-16 estimates; exceeding a target publishes a notice and does not itself reject generation or authorize a retry.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
notice_sink 18 Tracing can publish immediately; embedded callers collect on their owner.
reasoning_limit 30 Compute a soft threshold only for an execution phase with an explicit output denominator and enabled thinking. Internal phases, thinking-off retries and disabled-thinking overrides have no threshold; the request-local percentage defaults to fifty.
disable_thinking 47 Override only this request, preserving the user's normal saved choices.
ReasoningBudget 57 Use reported reasoning counts, otherwise the context estimator's UTF-16 / 3. No reasoning text is retained. A stream chunk is not treated as one token. Providers may report counts only at completion; streaming estimates allow a soft-target notice in that case and are explicitly marked as estimates.
ReasoningBudget.observe 80 Accumulate UTF-16 code units, prefer valid provider reasoning counts and estimate later unreported units at three units per token. Carry prior-prefix tokens and publish one threshold-exceeded notice without rejecting the response. A shared notice state suppresses repeat publication across continuation attempts.

src/agent_runtime/llm/budget.py

Python · Tier A

Own request-local inference accounting across execution and internal phases. Stop/steering checks, optional root deadlines and Agent Check enforcement guard physical attempts; a persisted reservation avoids charging the same attempt twice. Context bindings reset when a standalone result phase exits.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
InferenceBudget 22 Carry one root operation's inference-call allowance, absolute monotonic deadline, cancellation signal, usage and Agent Check context. Native dispatch shares this record across phases; a persisted reservation is consumed once rather than double-charged at transport entry.
InferenceBudget.check 31 Honor Stop, steering and the root deadline.
InferenceBudget.consume 55 Check cancellation, steering and the wall deadline, then consult the decision-limit Agent Check before incrementing the physical-call count. Enforcement can reject an exhausted allowance; observation-only policy can record the violation without stopping the call.
InferenceBudget.authorize_transport 73 Honor stop/deadline fences and clear one pre-reserved call without charging it again; otherwise consume a new standalone transport attempt.
result_phase 91 Bind an explicit internal phase and its owner budget only when no semantic budget is already active. Reject nested ownership, then restore both context variables on every exit.

src/agent_runtime/llm/budget_growth.py

Python · Tier A

Expose the native recovery owner's effective output and thinking allowances through request-local context. Shared clients keep saved defaults, internal phases ignore these overrides, and a scoped callback can request more thinking room without opening another transport.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
extend_thinking 26 Ask the owning decision for more room without replacing its transport.
scope 33 Bind effective budgets for this context and restore the previous value on exit.
active 42 Return execution-budget overrides only outside internal model phases.
overrides 49 Apply the effective output allowance without mutating configured request values.
percent 57 Return the scoped thinking percentage or the configured fallback.
thinking_disabled 63 Recognize explicit provider settings that disable reasoning generation.

src/agent_runtime/llm/client.py

Python · Tier A

LLM client interfaces.

Details

The foundation defines the boundary and includes a small OpenAI-compatible JSON client so the agent runtime can call a real model without extra dependencies.

Symbol Line Documentation

LLMClientError.provider_diagnostic 95 Not yet documented
LLMClientError.provider_diagnostic 99 Not yet documented
StaticLLMClient 105 Test placeholder that always returns a configured payload.
StaticLLMClient.complete_json 111 Return the static payload without contacting an external model.
OpenAICompatLLMClient 169 Tiny OpenAI-compatible structured JSON client using stdlib HTTP.
OpenAICompatLLMClient.model 202 Configured or discovered model id used for LLM requests.
OpenAICompatLLMClient.model 208 Not yet documented

OpenAICompatLLMClient._compatible_request 415 Not yet documented

src/agent_runtime/llm/continuation.py

Python · Tier A

Retain bounded unfinished assistant prefixes privately after an eligible token-limit stop. Rebuild a suffix request from the original accepted input and remaining allowance, with serving/layout/policy fences. Unsupported shapes hand off to ordinary bounded recovery; no partial tool executes and no reasoning prefix enters durable history.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Unavailable 37 An explicit handoff to the ordinary bounded decision retry.
scope 54 Carry one private checkpoint through the existing worker context boundary.
size 63 Bound retained request and prefix bytes, including non-ASCII content.
reasoning_count 70 Carry reported reasoning counts, otherwise the ordinary UTF-16 estimate.
Checkpoint 82 An in-memory prefix pinned to its original serving and request identity.
Checkpoint.request 98 Validate serving identity, selected semantic request fields and prompt-layout identity before building a suffix request from the original wire input. Append the retained assistant prefix, preserve the original total reasoning budget and reserve only total minus already-spent output. Missing capacity or changed identity yields an explicit unavailable reason.
Draft 154 One transport's private reasoning capture; visible content stays in assembly.
Draft.observe 171 Retain only an unambiguous reasoning channel within the private bound.
Draft.checkpoint 196 Retain only a confirmed length-stop prefix on a supported adapter with no partial native call. Enforce one-MiB prefix/four-MiB request bounds and an explicit output ceiling; charge at least that ceiling even if usage underreports. Preserve original request/layout/control identity across further continuations and return a content-free rejection reason otherwise.
Draft.merge 258 Nonstreamed content needs the same exact suffix concatenation as SSE.

src/agent_runtime/llm/discovery.py

Python · Tier A

Share process-local model metadata discovery across UI and native callers using single-flight futures and a 45-second successful-result cache. Return detached bounded metadata, isolate API- key/namespace identities and discard failed results after current waiters finish. Cache invalidation fences stale publication without cancelling its loader.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
normalized_endpoint 21 Normalize only proven URL equivalences; retain path/query/user/tenant scope.
ModelDiscoveryError 44 Provider-neutral failure shared by API and native discovery waiters.
endpoint_identity 52 Hash the scheme, host, effective port, trailing-slash-normalized path, query, optional namespace and API key for process-local cache ownership. This key omits URL user information and fragments; it is distinct from normalized_endpoint, which retains user information while validating a usable URL.
SingleFlight 72 Share one in-flight loader per key and optionally retain successful detached values in a bounded TTL/LRU cache. Failures reach current waiters but are not cached. The loader runs outside the lock; each caller receives its own deep copy.
SingleFlight.invalidate 85 Forget completed values and detach matching active futures so old work cannot refill an invalidated key. This does not cancel the loader or prevent its existing waiters from receiving its result.
SingleFlight.get 99 Serve an unexpired detached value or elect one loader while followers poll its future with cancellation checks. Force removes a completed value but still joins an existing flight. Only the currently registered flight can populate the TTL cache; publish errors to its waiters and remove ownership in finally.
safe_models 146 Project at most 512 entries into allowlisted model/provider/capacity fields with strings truncated to 512 characters and metadata nesting limited to two levels. Preserve only explicit top-level boolean image capability. Numeric capacity validity is left to later consumers; this shape filter does not prove model health or capability.

src/agent_runtime/llm/generation.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve phase-specific generation timing/thinking policy and detect stalled or repetitive private reasoning or extreme unfinished tool-argument loops before response acceptance. Keep answer prose diagnostic-only, project bounded fields and validate argument JSON without executing any operation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
generation_profile 45 Resolve timing and thinking extensions for the current phase. Compiler calls use their separate allowance and zero temperature; capability selection additionally disables thinking, caps output at 512 and applies its total deadline. Fresh recovery uses the selected recovery policy and optional deadline without silently shrinking ordinary output capacity.
GenerationProgressGuard 133 Progress-aware inactivity, reasoning loops and extreme tool-argument loops.
GenerationProgressGuard.__init__ 139 Capture the current quality-check policy and initialize a monotonic progress episode with separate startup, inactivity and optional total limits. Track only channel windows, numeric counters and repetition evidence needed for this response.
GenerationProgressGuard.progress 177 Mark the first meaningful progress and refresh its monotonic timestamp; later inactivity is measured from this event rather than request start.
GenerationProgressGuard.observe_counter 184 Treat a strictly increasing nonnegative safe-integer provider counter as progress. Ignore booleans, malformed, oversized or repeated values so heartbeats cannot indefinitely reset inactivity.
GenerationProgressGuard.observe 193 Count non-whitespace text as progress. Answers and small tool-data repetitions remain diagnostic-only; extreme unfinished tool data uses a higher threshold per call. Repetitive private reasoning also clears its steering prefix. Tool names are excluded from detection.
GenerationProgressGuard.remaining 252 Compute the next enforced inactivity/startup or explicit total deadline as a positive socket allowance, with a one-millisecond floor. Completed responses bypass quality timers but retain an explicit total deadline; no applicable limit yields None.
GenerationProgressGuard.check 267 Check the explicit total deadline independently of generation-quality policy, then detect startup silence or inactivity for an unfinished response. Observation-only quality checks can record faults without raising; disabled detection skips those quality timers.
GenerationProgressGuard.fail 304 Route a quality fault through Agent Check observation/enforcement with one episode-specific deduplication key. An enforced fault or explicit deadline raises an LLMClientError carrying numeric evidence and no-operation-authorized status, not private reasoning text.
visible_response 326 Project supported visible response fields for diagnostics, excluding provider reasoning/extensions. Normally retain one choice and two calls; forensic mode retains up to eight choices and sixteen calls with malformed-field evidence, then applies public-value filtering. This projection never authorizes a tool.
validate_arguments 417 Require each available tool call's argument string to decode as an object through the native protocol parser. Leave unknown-tool availability correction to its caller; translate malformed/recursive JSON to an inference error before it can enter execution history.

src/agent_runtime/llm/guidance_compact.py

Python · Tier A

Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.

src/agent_runtime/llm/message_stream.py

Python · Tier A

Scan fragmented JSON solely to preview its top-level message string. Preserve escape and nesting state without constructing nested values; malformed syntax or duplicate keys disables presentation. The complete native parser and schema validator independently decide whether the final response is usable.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
MessageStringExtractor 13 One pass over JSON syntax, retaining only keys and the top-level message. Nested values are skipped, never built into objects. Invalid syntax (including duplicate keys) permanently disables the preview. Final native parsing/schema validation remains independent and authoritative.
MessageStringExtractor.feed 42 Consume a fragment without constructing nested values and release only decoded characters from the root message string. Track complete JSON syntax and duplicate keys across fragments. Invalid syntax permanently disables extraction and discards this call's output; the presentation owner must withdraw any previously published prefix.
MessageStringExtractor._string_char 162 Carry escape and Unicode state across fragments, reject control characters and malformed escapes, and finish keys or values at a closing quote. Duplicate decoded keys or an unpaired surrogate permanently invalidate the scanner.

src/agent_runtime/llm/modalities.py

Python · Tier A

Interpret explicit active serving metadata for primary-model image input. Reject unsupported or stale endpoint/model capability observations without guessing from model names or contacting a provider; image projection and artifact authorization are separate consumers.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
from_metadata 9 Report image input only for an explicit boolean true in active top-level serving capabilities. Model names, nested training configuration and truthy strings are not evidence.
image_input 20 Require explicit image capability and, when the client recorded a serving identity, an unchanged endpoint/model pair. Clients without that identity marker can still supply explicit capabilities; this helper performs no discovery or image inference.

src/agent_runtime/llm/model_configuration.py

Python · Tier A

Define the generation-parameter catalog, validate explicit maps and resolve saved presets. Routed Main/Helper cards now pin their maps at save time; legacy admission can also resolve a profile. Request policy combines the selected role's settings with phase-specific thinking and execution-only growth/composer choices. Provider compatibility is negotiated by the transport; these pure helpers neither probe endpoints nor change persisted preferences.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ModelRequestParameter 87 Immutable catalog metadata; editor suggestions never imply configured values.
ModelRequestParameter.public 106 Return detached metadata with the provider field path and editor type.
number 115 Build a numeric JSON schema with optional inclusive bounds.
choices 124 Build a string-enum schema; provider/model support is documented separately.
array 129 Bound list size while preserving each parameter's item schema.
validate_overrides 719 Return a deep copy of an allowlisted, valid JSON map or raise ValueError. Presence preserves explicit zero/false/empty values. Validation never fills missing keys, coerces types, changes global settings or reflects private values in errors.
materialize_execution_request_overrides 766 Copy validated values to provider fields, without injecting defaults. Only the allowlisted thinking booleans map into chat_template_kwargs. Merge both without losing either value; arbitrary template arguments remain forbidden and explicit False must survive this mapping. This does not certify endpoint support. Wire compatibility may adapt optional fields; the native client separately retains max_tokens for version-0 saved runs only.
provider_family 811 Classify only first-party host or explicit discovery metadata; never probe.
recommended_overrides 822 One product starting point; the wire layer negotiates endpoint support.
resolve_configuration 838 Resolve a new task's profile, map, reservation and version without I/O. Callers supply the selected model and an already normalized internal allowance. Saved runs must use their pinned result rather than reapplying current presets.
execution_reservation 862 Execution context budgeting only; internal callers retain client.max_tokens.
execution_decision 877 Mark one normal decision in request-local context and always restore the caller.
is_execution_request 886 Require an explicit decision scope and exclude internal phases. A Task Contract phase always wins over an enclosing execution scope, so its saved thinking policy applies independently on every initial/retry transport.
configuration_diagnostic 897 Expose profile/reservation and key counts without private parameter contents.
request_policy 917 Assemble the single policy used by payload construction and diagnostics. Execution starts with validated explicit overrides and budget growth; internal phases use their own allowance plus the selected role's saved map. Phase extensions win, disabled thinking removes conflicting controls, and managed-instance launches own preservation flags. Version-zero saved runs retain their legacy max_tokens wire spelling. No preference or client map is mutated.
request_profile 986 Diagnostics use the same resolved settings as payload construction.
rejected_configuration_keys 991 Match configured catalog keys in a provider error only during normal execution.
rejection_guidance 1010 Explain validated catalog-key rejections without retaining provider error text.

src/agent_runtime/llm/model_output_capture.py

Python · Tier A

Capture provider-emitted text for the on-demand inspector, separate from public answer/history projection. Own per-channel redaction, chunk batching, flush timers and terminal metadata, with explicit selection/compiler exclusions and bounded storage-error handling.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ModelOutputCapture 27 Own a request/call debug transcript separately from normal trace events. Redact each channel incrementally, coalesce bounded text chunks and flush on size, a timer or closure. Captured tool arguments remain diagnostic text and confer no execution authority.
ModelOutputCapture.text 59 Ignore all capability-selection text and task-contract reasoning, then feed each nonempty string through its channel's TRACES redactor. Streaming redactors retain incomplete sensitive fragments until more text or final closure; this helper expects serialized caller access.
ModelOutputCapture.observe 92 Under the capture lock, inspect the first provider choice before normal response projection. Retain finish reason, safe top-level usage, known reasoning/answer fields and at most 64 indexed tool channels; flush at 8,192 characters or schedule a 250-ms tail timer.
ModelOutputCapture.flush 135 Cancel the outstanding timer and write pending redacted chunks under the reentrant lock, then clear the buffer. Metadata-only changes wait for closure; unavailable storage drops pending output rather than retrying writes.
ModelOutputCapture.close 147 Close at most once, finalize every channel redactor, flush its tail and publish terminal status, timestamp, finish reason, usage and error identity. Closure does not certify that captured output is a valid answer.
record_output 166 Forward one provider object to the context-owned capture, if any. Streaming mode selects delta fields; this observes returned output without altering the provider object.
record_request 174 Store only allowlisted generation parameters from the outgoing request, including the actual output cap. Prompts, messages, credentials and the full request body are not copied here.
capture_output 195 Start one capture and bind it to this execution context. Apply selection/compiler exclusions, finish as completed or classify supported cancellation exceptions, and restore the previous capture on exit. Only OSError/SQLite start failures are isolated; other lifecycle errors remain visible.

src/agent_runtime/llm/named_result.py

Python · Tier A

Validate and extract bounded internal model results as data. Require the named function and supplied schema, with plain text allowed only by explicit single-field opt-in. Preserve the original provider response and report safe validation-stage diagnostics without entering action dispatch.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
result_value 19 Extract a validated single-field text result or parse the arguments of the exact requested result function. The caller must first validate the complete envelope; returned data is not an executable action.
validate_named_result 34 Validate envelope, exact function identity, JSON arguments and the supplied result schema in that order. Explicit text-result opt-in permits plain text; a local projection tolerates stop on a structured result without changing the original payload. Report safe stage-specific errors, retain the reported finish cause and return the untouched response only on success.

src/agent_runtime/llm/native_protocol.py

Python · Tier A

Validate complete native response wrappers and parse unambiguous argument objects before execution can be considered. Explicit compiler/text-result modes change only their allowed envelope shape; argument schemas, operation availability and authorization remain with downstream owners.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
arguments_object 27 Decode one complete JSON argument string into an object. Reject duplicate keys at any depth, non- JSON numeric constants, overflow to non-finite floats and non-object roots. This parses data only; availability, argument schemas and execution authorization remain separate checks.
validate_envelope 60 Require one complete assistant choice and a bounded list of uniquely identified function calls, or an explicitly allowed nonempty text result. A length stop reports truncation before dispatch. Validate wrappers here, leaving argument JSON and schemas to their owners; compiler prose-discard returns a copied projection rather than mutating the provider payload.
call_identity 186 Deep-copy a call for comparison and normalize valid JSON argument strings to objects so equivalent object spellings compare alike. Malformed strings remain literal; this helper neither repairs nor executes a call.

src/agent_runtime/llm/native_stream.py

Python · Tier A

Reconstruct one native response from SSE fragments, with bounded call identities and private reasoning observations. Expose counts and rejected visible projections for diagnostics, normalize the completed response and leave final validation to the transport. Private steering capture is a separate collaborator; partial projections never authorize execution.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
reject 25 Raise a protocol failure with a stable stream category and explicit no-operation-authorized evidence. Callers supply safe diagnostic text rather than raw provider fragments.
NativeStreamAssembler 40 Reconstruct one provider choice privately while tracking content-free receipt counters. Share reasoning only with the private steering/quality owners; expose partial visible data solely as diagnostic evidence. Final normalization and independent protocol/schema checks are still required before execution.
NativeStreamAssembler.__init__ 44 Allocate one inference identity, fragment buffers, bounded call-index map and channel counters. Optional progress/reasoning guards observe this attempt; available tool names help the compatibility layer resolve fragmented names.
NativeStreamAssembler.progress 67 Return numeric channel counts, metadata-drift count, inference identity and elapsed guard time. This snapshot contains no answer, tool arguments or private reasoning text.
NativeStreamAssembler.add 86 Accept one unambiguous SSE object, merge safe metadata and usage, then append one consistent assistant choice. Permit usage-only events after completion but reject further choice deltas. Count reasoning privately, keep legacy and modern call channels mutually exclusive, and feed visible channels to progress detection without dispatching them.
NativeStreamAssembler._add_call 243 Accumulate name, ID and argument fragments by integer index in the range 0..63. Permit an omitted index only while order is unambiguous. Invalid IDs become repairable metadata; ambiguous function fields, invalid argument representations and non-function calls fail the stream. Only name/argument text counts as actionable output.
NativeStreamAssembler.envelope 319 Require a terminal marker or DONE with assembled content, reconstruct compatible name/argument fragments, and normalize the completed envelope. Broken or repeated full IDs defer to inference-scoped identity synthesis. This yields a protocol candidate, not execution permission; an unfinished stream raises an explicit no-operation-authorized error.
NativeStreamAssembler.partial_envelope 354 Copy accumulated visible content, ordered call fragments and retained metadata into a diagnostic envelope. Exclude reasoning text and keep incomplete arguments as received; this projection must never enter executable provider history.

src/agent_runtime/llm/native_tool_client.py

Python · Tier A

Native tool and internal-result transport over the compatible HTTP client.

Details

Normal AgentLoop decisions opt into the saved execution override map explicitly. Compiler and named-result calls retain their separate generation policy. Context reservation and optional provider output fields are separate identities.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
NativeToolCallLLMClient 68 Atomic native calls. The runtime owns tools, conversation, and continuation.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.supports_native_streaming 75 Not yet documented
NativeToolCallLLMClient.__init__ 91 Not yet documented
NativeToolCallLLMClient._served_models 174 Not yet documented
NativeToolCallLLMClient.prepare_run 255 Refresh new runs; verify and preserve the immutable identity of resumes.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.context_request 393 Bind template-affecting wire options for a non-generating counter.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.measure_context 452 Try a positively usable chat counter, then retain the local estimate.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.preflight_context 559 Measure input against the caller's phase-specific output reservation. Execution callers may reserve output without emitting a provider limit. Compiler/recovery callers reserve their unchanged internal generation allowance. Both streaming and non-streaming transport use the resulting capacity check.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.complete_tools 655 Return a validated envelope, preserving model tool arguments exactly.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.complete_tools_stream 676 Reconstruct privately, projecting only credential-safe provisional answers.
NativeToolCallLLMClient._post 699 Not yet documented
NativeToolCallLLMClient._post_native_stream 737 Not yet documented
NativeToolCallLLMClient._complete_tools 1077 Not yet documented
NativeToolCallLLMClient.complete_json 1588 Compatibility for explicitly invoked bounded internal result phases.
NativeToolCallLLMClient.complete_json_stream 1629 Not yet documented

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/init.py

Python · Tier A

Bounded, provider-neutral wire compatibility; never execution authority.

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/capabilities.py

Python · Tier A

Retain bounded compatibility evidence and materialize detached provider requests after explicit setup rejection. Run-local adaptations preserve accepted intent; the credential-scoped TTL/LRU cache supplies future snapshots without changing saved configuration, local validation or scheduling.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
_error_evidence 65 Extract message/type text and string field locations from recognized error/detail containers, bounded to four nested levels and 64 entries. Ignore echoed input objects; non-JSON error text remains available for narrow phrase matching.
_named_rejections 104 Match explicit unsupported-field phrases or structured locations against fields actually present on the wire, including known streaming/thinking aliases. Stop field lists at unrelated words so an echoed value or later explanation cannot authorize arbitrary omission.
endpoint_key 148 Hash a normalized endpoint, model, credential and optional managed namespace into a process-local compatibility identity. Lowercase scheme/netloc and omit fragments; retain path/query distinctions without storing plaintext credentials in snapshots.
clean_snapshot 163 Detach and validate the version-one support/adaptation shape, retaining only recognized features, optional-field omissions, a positive bounded active capacity and one supported output-token spelling. Invalid or old-version input becomes an empty current snapshot.
cached_snapshot 190 Return a detached cached observation or an empty snapshot, expiring entries after 300 monotonic seconds and moving hits to the LRU tail. Expiry does not alter already-created run-local states.
clear_cache 204 Discard all process-level observations under the cache lock, without changing snapshots already held by active runs.
invalidate 212 Forget this endpoint/launch cache identity after explicit replacement. Existing CompatibilityState owners remain independent; this operation neither cancels requests nor rewrites accepted tasks.
CompatibilityState 221 Own a detached run-local record of observed support and wire adaptations. Unsupported features stay disabled within this owner, while the bounded process cache supplies observations to future owners; no method here performs network I/O or grants execution authority.
CompatibilityState.snapshot 231 Return a deep copy under the run-local lock so callers can persist or inspect observations without mutating live adaptations.
CompatibilityState.observe 237 Record recognized support evidence without re-enabling an already unsupported run-local feature, then publish that feature to the shared cache. Unknown features are ignored.
CompatibilityState.observe_capacity 249 Accept only positive non-boolean integer capacities through 2^31 and lower this owner's known ceiling monotonically. Publish its current adaptation snapshot; the cache is not an authority over already-pinned run settings.
CompatibilityState.materialize 286 Deep-copy canonical intent, translate an observed output-token alias before removing rejected optional fields, and apply dependent stream/logprob/strict omissions. Weaken named/required tool choice only under the single-tool safeguards; never mutate saved preferences or local schema validation.
CompatibilityState.accept 326 Record features used by a successful Chat Completions request without undoing this owner's earlier unsupported evidence. Publish only observed support keys; successful acceptance does not certify every advertised model capability.
CompatibilityState.reject 358 Allow a changed wire request only for listed setup HTTP statuses and explicit unsupported- field evidence, excluding context/auth/rate/schema/value failures. Record exact negative support or narrow generic suppression, enforce single-tool choice safeguards, and publish only if materialization changes.
CompatibilityState.diagnostic 432 Report retry/omission counts, recognized wire field names, output spelling and stream flags without parameter values or request text. A preserved output-token alias is not counted as an omitted output limit.

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/context.py

Python · Tier A

Measure bound chat requests through optional non-generating vendor adapters and active serving- capacity metadata. Keep exact counts separate from estimates, preserve cancellation and context rejection, and avoid treating a transient counter outage as global unsupported evidence.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
backend_hint 22 Recognize only explicit owned_by values for vLLM or llama.cpp. Model-name guesses and other metadata do not select a vendor adapter.
active_model_capacity 29 Accept only a positive non-boolean top-level served max_model_len through 2^31. Nested training capacities and malformed scalar types are not active-server evidence.
active_server_capacity 68 For identified llama.cpp only, read model-scoped /props once per endpoint/model/credential identity and retain n_ctx plus reasoning metadata. Cache unsuccessful capacity observations locally too; cancellation propagates, while expected metadata failures leave capacity unknown.
measure_tokens 119 Choose a non-generating counter that can represent the bound request: llama.cpp full chat count, plain-message template/tokenize fallback, or supported /tokenize fields. Skip vendor routes for api.openai.com and keep option/tool-blind counts labeled estimates. Preserve typed cancellation and context rejection; classify unsupported, transient and malformed counter results for run- local fallback.

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/llama_reasoning.py

Python · Tier A

Discover llama.cpp reasoning fields through pre-inference request validation.

Details

The native completion schema validates samplers after reasoning fields. An invalid sampler entry fences the request before it is queued, even when an older server ignores a reasoning field. Verify that fence first; never use successful request acceptance or a build identifier as capability evidence.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
advertised 20 Read independent sampling capabilities, without interpreting build_info.
validation_error 31 Accept only bounded structured HTTP 400 validation errors, never HTTP 200.
discover 52 Refresh per-client evidence periodically, scoped to endpoint/model/auth/role. No user prompt or completion ID is used. The zero-token limit is a second guard if an incompatible proxy accepts invalid samplers. Such acceptance is never evidence. Cancellation propagates and failures remain retryable after a short TTL.

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/reasoning.py

Python · Tier A

Interpret serving metadata and non-generating validation for optional reasoning controls. Cache evidence by endpoint/model/credential/role identity and honor later request rejection. Unverified features remain unavailable; discovery never requests generated tokens.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
identity 18 Bind reasoning capability evidence to normalized endpoint, resolved model, credential identity and compatibility namespace. Do not share advertised support across roles or changed credentials.
llama_metadata 31 Cache advertised llama.cpp sampling/control fields under the selected serving identity. Unadvertised fields can be discovered at the next execution decision, never during startup.
discover 43 Discover llama.cpp fields with guarded validation or read vLLM's advertised request schema. Preserve cancellation and treat malformed/unavailable evidence as unknown support.
available 76 Require affirmative metadata for the current serving identity and no normal-transport rejection or suppression for the feature. Backend naming alone does not establish support.

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/response.py

Python · Tier A

Normalize harmless provider representation differences into one controller-owned response envelope. Preserve duplicate-key evidence, reject ambiguous fragments, sanitize telemetry and reconstruct call identities; native protocol and tool-schema validation still decide whether the result is usable.
